attributes.action: Make leg room on Busses 1/2” bigger for  all
attributes.additional_details: So based off of my petition i would like on behalf of the tall community to have a comfortable bus journey by having that extra leg room, by spacing the seats out just that tiny bit more so im much more comfortable to be able to enjoy my bus ride. Im sure the tall population and even the smaller population will enjoy that tiny bit of extra leg room so we can all be comfortable
attributes.background: i find it hard being really tall on the bus and not being able to sit down comfortably at all, it ruins my bus experience, however with them couple of inches it would allow me to be more comfortable and not have my knees being crushed against the chair

rejection.details: This is not a matter of direct responsibility for the UK Government or Parliament and is  a matter for local authorities and bus companies in terms of their procurement requirements & standards
